10k.note: 10-K describes IQVIA as a contract research organization (CRO) and provider of advanced analytics, technology, and clinical research services to the life sciences industry. No proprietary drug or device pipeline disclosed.

website.error: no public pipeline page — IQVIA does not maintain a drug/device pipeline page (CRO/services business).

ctgov.trials_returned_note: All trials surfaced for IQVIA-related entities (IQVIA Biotech, IQVIA Pty Ltd, IQVIA RDS, etc.) appear as collaborator / contracted CRO on third-party sponsors' trials (AstraZeneca, Milestone Pharmaceuticals, Hutchison Medipharma, Spero, etc.). No proprietary IQVIA-owned investigational asset identified.

excluded_partner_owned.asset: Various sponsor-owned trials with IQVIA as contracted CRO/collaborator
excluded_partner_owned.reason: IQVIA serves as the contract research organization on these trials; the investigational assets are owned by the lead sponsors (e.g., AstraZeneca's Nirsevimab NCT06042049; Milestone Pharmaceuticals' Etripamil NCT04072835). Per workflow rule, partner/sponsor-owned trials are excluded.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Distribution / services company — no proprietary clinical pipeline. IQVIA is a contract research organization (CRO) and life-sciences technology/analytics provider; it conducts trials on behalf of pharma/biotech sponsors but does not develop or own clinical-stage drug or device assets.
